name: Result State
intent: Express the outcome of a submitted task, page-level operation, or workflow step with one clear semantic result and a useful next action.

representativeVariants.title: 提交失败
representativeVariants.supporting: 网络异常，内容尚未提交。

representativeVariants.title: 已完成，但仍需处理
representativeVariants.supporting: 当前结果已保存，请补充缺失信息。

representativeVariants.title: 已收到申请
representativeVariants.supporting: 后续状态会在这里更新。

representativeVariants.title: 正在处理
representativeVariants.supporting: 可以离开此页面，处理完成后状态会更新。

interactionContract: At most one visually Primary action is allowed for one result state.
Recoverable error Primary action SHOULD retry, resubmit, or return to an editable state; failure is never represented by a disabled dead-end CTA alone.
Success Primary action points to a real next step or durable result instead of a mechanical OK button.
Pending explains whether the user may leave, return later, or expect automatic state change.
Field-level validation errors MUST remain owned by field/form validation and MUST NOT promote a local field error to Result State.
accessibilityContract: Tone is communicated by semantic icon/visual plus readable copy and structure; color is never the only carrier.
The semantic result, title, explanation, and next action remain available to assistive technology.
Decorative visual does not steal focus when the result state appears.
Action order follows reading order and one Primary action remains distinguishable without color alone.

platformPresentationRefs.note: Page-level Result State consumes platform geometry and accessibility facts without changing result semantics.

structurePatterns: semantic visual -> title -> supporting/result summary -> optional detail/meta -> actions
centered page-level or bounded task-region composition; not a thin notification strip
one Primary action maximum; optional Secondary action remains visually subordinate
Result State does not absorb environment/system-block states merely because they also have an icon and action
usageHints: use for success/error/warning/info/pending outcomes after a task or submission reaches a result state
use Inline Alert for local persistent feedback and Banner for page/region persistent notification
use Blocking State semantics for offline, permission denied, system unavailable, or other external task blocks
doNotInvent: no Success Page/Error Page forks with different component identities
no generic OK button when a meaningful next action exists
